items.title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 at lower prices
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2 (open to all API customers and in the Claude apps) and Mythos 5.2 (a restricted tier for vetted cybersecurity and life-science users). Both are priced at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. Anthropic says outputs are up to 30% faster than 5.1 and better at coding, reasoning and vision. It also claims that 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents formalized Fermat's Last Theorem in about 30 hours (Anthropic's own claim, no proof artifacts published).
items.why_it_matters: Newest top-tier model from a leading lab, with a price cut and a split between public and restricted access.

items.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Hydrogen as its agent 'daily driver'
items.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a cheaper tier of the Gemini 4 family. It costs $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, with a 1M-token context window. It scores 51 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at high thinking (54 at xhigh). Available in AI Studio, the Gemini API, the Gemini app, Search, Sheets and Antigravity. Separate from the already-covered Gemini 4 Carbon.

sources.name: Google blog (cited by AI Weekly; not opened)

items.why_it_matters: Frontier-level agent performance at lower price lowers deployment costs and increases pricing pressure.

items.title: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory security agents on GPT-6 Cyber
items.summary: At a keynote, Greg Brockman launched Daybreak Red Team (early access), which uses agent fleets to pen-test web apps, and Daybreak Defense Factory, which uses agents built on GPT-6 Cyber to scan codebases and prepare merge-ready patches.
items.why_it_matters: OpenAI turns a specialised model into packaged enterprise products, competing with Anthropic's Mythos tier.

items.title: Meituan releases LongCat-2.5, a 1.6T open-weight model, under the MIT license
items.summary: Meituan published the weights of LongCat-2.5 on Hugging Face under the MIT license. Mixture-of-experts with 1.6T total parameters and about 48B active per token. Reports 88.4 on Terminal Bench v2.1. Hosted inference $0.30 per million input tokens and $1.20 per million output tokens.
items.why_it_matters: A large, commercially usable open-weight Chinese model keeps pressure on closed Western labs.

items.title: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 and AlphaGenome 2
items.summary: DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, reportedly reaching 96% on a Mercedes-Benz production line task, tested with Apptronik. AlphaGenome 2 finds causal DNA variants 30% of the time on TenK10K versus 16% for its predecessor. Company-reported figures.
items.why_it_matters: Capability milestones in physical AI and biology.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; Colette Kress named interim CEO
items.summary: Nvidia's board announced Jensen Huang is stepping down immediately as president, CEO and board member. CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO and former Synopsys CEO Harvey Jones becomes Nvidia's first-ever Chair. The change followed a board probe into reports about Huang.
items.why_it_matters: Nvidia chips underpin every frontier lab; a sudden CEO change affects the supply chain and market sentiment.
